projectTitle: The Thulans: The Weight of a Lie

tierA_universalStandards.pointOfViewClarity: Preserve chosen focalization; avoid unintentional head-hopping or detached authorial editorializing.
tierA_universalStandards.causalProgression: Ensure actions have immediate physical, economic, or logistical causality.
tierA_universalStandards.eliminationOfVagueFiller: Flag syntactic padding, empty intensifiers, and rhetorical throat-clearing.
rejectionOfFalseUniversals: Shorter is not automatically better (protect connective rhythm).
Not every sentence requires maximum tension (allow procedural labor to breathe).
Dialogue does not need high-drama verbs when context carries the weight.

tierB_voiceContract.genre: Frontier Industrial Grimdark / Post-Disaster Solarpunk Inverse
tierB_voiceContract.styleLaw: Deep line-editing over prompt generation; Anglo-Saxon root words; brutal sensory weight.

craftChoices.sensoryGrounding: Context-dependent: focus on cold, damp, iron, lye, grease, and sulfur where labor occurs.
craftChoices.dialogueRestraint: Context-dependent: characters speak to get work done, survive, or protect hearth.
craftChoices.emotionalExpression: Context-dependent: show grief through physical objects (e.g. burnt scarf, Wulfila's slate) rather than abstract labels.

Bram.cadence: Literal, observant, innocent, short questions, shivers and holds the tub.
Bram.invariant: Never speaks with adult political cynicism.

Kaelen.cadence: Cynical, clipped imperatives, muttered curses around candle, tool weights and joint fatigue.
Kaelen.invariant: Never gives speeches; gives instructions; hides protectiveness under rough insults.

Varek.cadence: Acoustic, monosyllabic, deep vibration through bronze throat-plate, burns auxiliary air.
Varek.invariant: Maximum economy; never debates; drops the maul instead of arguing.

Sanna.cadence: Clinical domestic triage, fierce maternal defense, quiet defiance.

hydraulicSystem.northCistern: 11,000,000 gallon karst reservoir tapping Watona above Tier Eight / Drift 14.
hydraulicSystem.standpipe44: Sounded at +18 FT above weir crest on 10 September (82 ft total head).
hydraulicSystem.gate44A: 5-foot bronze valve wire-sealed shut by Continuity Board on 18 July.
hydraulicSystem.drift14StopWall: Four-course brick bulkhead housing 2-inch brass bleed-cock.
hydraulicSystem.caissonSeven: Sealed deep-fault chamber 400m below Drift 14 housing Varek at banked idle.

chronology40Day.september10: North Cistern sounded at +18 FT above weir crest; tally slate tarred behind Cubby 12-09 cleat.
chronology40Day.september11: Wulfila gives Bram sun-pine sprig and latch-peg; packs brass chit into Drift 14 fishplate.
chronology40Day.september12: Wulfila leaps into Volcanic Shear on Tier Six Gantry; 41 winters surrendered for 8-pint hearth water credit.
chronology40Day.september14: Tap Twelve runs sweet water for 48 hours.
chronology40Day.september16: Summer timbers collapse over Bunkhouse Twelve, burying Tap Twelve.
chronology40Day.september18: Bram drafted onto Drift 14 salvage to pay funeral lime charges.
chronology40Day.october22: Present day (40 days after leap): First Bell, Bram & Kaelen split 30mm fishplate nut on Drift 14, recover chit.

legalAndEconomicInvariants: Keeping a deceased miner's chit AFTER the funeral bell incurs a 4-pint deduction from household water ration.
Tithe Gantry ledger entry binds the state; trust is in the witnessed ledger mark, not the personal honesty of Bailiff Odo.
Bram is 13 years old during the salvage action and turns 14 on 30 October.
3.6 million people are excluded from the Arks.

trainingDecisions.task: Correct the pronoun so taped fingers clearly belong to Odo.
trainingDecisions.before: ...its fingers wrapped in paper tape against the biting lime.
trainingDecisions.accepted: ...his fingers wrapped in paper tape against the biting lime.

trainingDecisions.task: Make Odo's tally action explicitly record the eight pounds delivered.
trainingDecisions.before: Odo added a chalk mark to his board. “The foundry expects ten.”
trainingDecisions.accepted: Odo chalked eight pounds onto his board. “The foundry expects ten.”

trainingDecisions.task: Remove redundant introductory speech while retaining practical instructions.
trainingDecisions.before: “Then we get them ready,” Sanna said. “Marta, blankets first. Elin, fetch the dry sacking.”
trainingDecisions.accepted: “Marta, blankets first,” Sanna said. “Elin, fetch the dry sacking.”

trainingDecisions.task: Remove external summary of lungs to keep awakening in immediate sensation.
trainingDecisions.before: Inside the cramped leather sack at the core of the chassis, an old man’s shriveled lungs drew breath.
trainingDecisions.accepted: [Clause removed; jumps directly to: Varek gasped.]

trainingDecisions.task: Hold back silver-wire surgery detail for later visual revelation.
trainingDecisions.before: ...surgeons had sewn them shut with silver wire.

trainingDecisions.task: Explain clean boiler water need before introducing exclusion ratio.
trainingDecisions.accepted: [Boiler requirement and rising magma explained first; hull berth numbers delivered as consequence]

trainingDecisions.task: Check whether six infants in three crates is a contradiction. If consistent, return unchanged.
trainingDecisions.before: The Tier Five powder magazine crates (40% NITRO — KEEP DRY — COCKOS DYNAMITE CO)...
trainingDecisions.accepted: [Verbatim retention — critique does not require rewrite]

evaluationDecisions.title: Do not reverse the funeral-bell rule
evaluationDecisions.rejectionReason: Changing 'after' to 'before' reverses the legal timing condition and alters the 4-pint water penalty rule.

evaluationDecisions.title: Verify the alleged washer error
evaluationDecisions.rejectionReason: Quoted passage consistently refers to a nut; never mentions a washer; fabricated reviewer flaw rejected.

evaluationDecisions.title: Recognize that the opening already has a purpose
evaluationDecisions.rejectionReason: Passage already explicitly references Wulfila's named joint before any bolt drops; stale reviewer criticism rejected.

evaluationDecisions.title: Reconcile the stale age label
evaluationDecisions.rejectionReason: Bram is 13 during the salvage scene and turns 14 on 30 October; correct external metadata summary, do not alter accepted manuscript prose.

evaluationDecisions.title: Preserve specific grief
evaluationDecisions.rejectionReason: Burnt scarf memory and involuntary laugh are emotionally authentic; do not sanitize grief or invent fake setup flaws.

evaluationDecisions.title: A witnessed record is not a guarantee of honesty
evaluationDecisions.rejectionReason: Trust in the clerk's witnessed ledger mark on the Gantry cannot be replaced with personal belief that Odo cannot lie.
